Purple Tentacle is\254\001Man of the Year
Ah-ha!\255\003A secret passage!\255\003This is all too easy!
Oh, just something I whipped up in my spare time.
^until one of them tried to take over the world.
Had to tie the little buggers up in the basement.
Good thing you told us that.
Yeah, Bernard wanted us to set them free!
Thank God you weren't THAT stupid.
Now I can finish TAKING OVER THE WORLD!\255\003Ha ha ha!
Uh^\255\003I'll try to talk him out of it.
Well, what possible harm could one insane, mutant tentacle do?
What have you done this time, you meddling milquetoast?
Now Purple Tentacle is free to use his evil mutant powers to take over the world^\255\003^and ENSLAVE ALL HUMANITY!
Our only hope now is to turn off my Sludge-O-Matic\015 machine^
^and prevent the toxic mutagen from entering the river!
Isn't it a little late for that, Doctor?
Of course!\255\003That's why I'll have to do it^
This is all your fault, Bernard.
Doc, can't you just send Bernard?
No, you must all go, to increase the odds that one of you will make it there alive!
Have any people ever been hurt in this thing?
This is the first time I've ever tried it on PEOPLE!
And they said imitation diamond wasn't good enough!
What happened to Hoagie and Laverne?!?
I KNEW I should have bought a REAL diamond!
My dials say that the larger specimen landed two hundred years in the past^
^and the other is stuck two hundred years in the future!
Well, hurry up and bring them back!
I will, as soon as I get a new diamond!
Then all your buddies have to do is plug in their respective Chron-O-Johns and--
Plug them in?!?\255\003Where is Hoagie going to find an electrical outlet TWO HUNDRED YEARS IN THE PAST!?!
Yes^  well^\255\003He'll be needing my patented super-battery then, won't he?
Now, where did I put those patented super-battery plans of mine?
Plans?  How are we going to get Hoagie PLANS?
Don't worry me with details, boy!\255\003Just help me find the plans!
Now what am I going to do?
I think I made myself perfectly clear^
Step Three:  Get Out of My House!
